steps.title: Summarize Northwatch
steps.body: Type `enable` and `show ip route ospf`: four Northwatch routes, 10.30.0.0/24 to 10.30.3.0/24. Work out the one summary that covers exactly those four and `submit SUMMARY=<network>/<prefix>`. Then summarize area 1 on this ABR: `conf t`, `router ospf 1`, `area 1 range 10.30.0.0 255.255.252.0`, `end`, and check `show ip route ospf` again.

objectives.label: Saw one route instead of four

steps.title: Find the single point of failure
steps.body: Read `more flash:design-review.txt`. Name the one device every outpost depends on: `submit SPOF=<device>`.

steps.title: Price the second radio
steps.body: From the same file: each radio link is up 99% of the time. Two independent links fail together only 1% × 1% of the time. `submit AVAIL=<percent>` with two decimals.
